scenes.title: 이래도 언리얼을 선택할까?
lines: Rebuilding the same door leaves one question. If Blueprints were the reason you chose Unreal, would you still choose it after this change? All three engines can build this door. The choice depends on what is outside it. Say you already have dozens of maps and characters in Unreal, and your team knows its lighting and animation tools. That is a good reason to finish the game in UE5. Even for a new game, if you intend to publish inside Fortnite, building and playtesting in UEFN fits that goal. A team building its first room can consider Godot and Unity from the start.

scenes.title: 고도는 상용 게임도 무료
lines: In Godot, group the door leaf and switch as nodes in a scene. When the switch emits a signal, GDScript on the door can check the key and rotate the leaf. Godot has a clear advantage here. The engine is free. There is no engine fee per developer as the team grows, and game sales do not trigger engine royalties. Godot also publishes its engine source under the MIT license. When shipping the engine with your game, include its copyright and license notice in your credits or documentation.

scenes.title: 유니티는 팀과 좌석을 본다
lines: In Unity, create a GameObject for the door. Attach a C# script as a component to implement the same rule. If your team knows C# and already owns suitable Unity assets, that can shorten the time to a first playable room. Pricing depends on the team's finances over the last 12 months. For a team making its own game, combined revenue and funding of up to $200,000 qualify for free Unity Personal. Above that threshold, a team on Unity Pro pays US$2,310 per seat per year on the US prepaid annual plan.

scenes.title: 같은 게임의 엔진 비용
lines: Let's compare all three with one set of numbers. Imagine a two-person team's first PC game, sold only on Steam. Its first quarter takes lifetime gross revenue to $1.2 million. The engine fee payable to Godot is still $0. Two prepaid annual Unity Pro seats cost $4,620. Under Unreal's current standard game royalty terms, the first $1 million in lifetime gross product revenue is excluded. Here, 5% of the remaining $200,000 is $10,000. These figures compare payments to the engine provider. Store fees and labor are separate costs.

scenes.title: 우리 팀에 남는 선택
lines: The Blueprint announcement alone cannot choose an engine for our team. If you have substantial Unreal work, start with the value of that investment. If you can reuse C# code and assets, look at Unity. If you are starting fresh and want zero engine fees and royalties plus the freedom to modify the engine, Godot has a strong case. If you are undecided, build that door and the first room in your two finalists. See how quickly your team can change it and run it again on your target device. That experience will tell you which engine fits your game.
